0022600041.text: The Sacramento Kings (1-9) host the Portland Trail Blazers (6-3) as they try to snap a three-game losing streak; the Kings are 0-5 at home and sit 5th in the Pacific, 8 games back, while Portland is 3rd in the Northwest, 1.5 games back. The Kings are missing Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery) and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), and Portland is without Ja Morant (hamstring), Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery), and Vit Krejci (ankle). Portland leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after winning 128-120 in Sacramento on October 23, and it also beat the Kings in all four meetings in 2025-26.
